candidates.name: OGC GeoPose
verified_facts: OGC GeoPose defines interoperable exchange of location and orientation of real or virtual objects within reference frames.
GeoPose standardizes data structures and encodings but does not constrain or interpret external reference-frame specifications.
semantic_limits: A valid GeoPose object does not prove the reference frame is the required parcel measurement CRS/datum or that its position and height were surveyed to the needed accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC GeoAPI
verified_facts: OGC GeoAPI defines Java types and methods for manipulating geographic information structured according to adopted ISO and OGC specifications.
It standardizes the software contract between geographic-information client code and implementing libraries.
semantic_limits: API or library conformance does not validate the precision, lineage, classification, datum or survey accuracy of geographic data passed through the API.
